_noteP: P (Dauntless Vanguard mark-pop) curated (T7 extension), unblocked by two additive engine fixes: (1) SkillHit.hpPercentCalc lets a %maxHP fraction be sourced from a full GameCalculation (see Skarner P for the first use of this field) instead of only a flat DataValues entry; (2) SkillDamage.BuildStatResolver now honors mStatFormula==2 on mStat ids 1 (Armor) and 6 (MR) the same way it already did for id 2 (AD), resolving to BONUS Armor/MR instead of always TOTAL. KSanteP.mSpellCalculations 'MaxHealthDamagePercent' mFormulaParts = [ NamedDataValue(MaxHealthDamagePercentBase=0.01), StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=1 Armor, mStatFormula=2, mDataValue=MaxHealthDamageResistRatio=0.0001), StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=6 MR, mStatFormula=2, mDataValue=MaxHealthDamageResistRatio=0.0001) ], summed directly (no explicit SumOfSubParts wrapper needed -- FormulaInterpreter.Evaluate sums top-level mFormulaParts the same way) = 1%maxHP + 0.01%maxHP per point of BONUS armor + 0.01%maxHP per point of BONUS MR, flat across all levels/ranks (both DataValues are constant arrays). Modeled hpBasis Max, type PHYSICAL (§11.E fix, loop 106: the earlier 'True' was a curator inference from an old tooltip and is WRONG — the current wiki, wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/K'Sante Dauntless Instinct, states the mark-pop / All Out bonus is PHYSICAL, consistent with Q/W/R which were already corrected Magic->Physical this file; the BIN calc itself carries no damage-type field, consistent with every other champion here, so the type is a wiki call). Curated as ONE proc (count 1) representing one full mark-pop; the passive's 3-hits-to-mark-then-pop stacking sequence is a combo-sequencing detail out of scope here. Verified safe: the Armor/MR mStatFormula fix only changes behavior for a calc part that has BOTH mStat in {1,6} AND mStatFormula==2 -- audited every other currently hand-curated champion file and found none with that combination that actually evaluates (the one near-miss, Taric E's 'TotalDamage', maps to a DIFFERENT BIN spell object -- TaricPassive's clean Armor-scaling calc, not TaricE's own tooltipOnly/EffectValueCalculationPart-first calc, which still fails before reaching any stat term -- so Taric's curated number is provably unchanged). [SUPERSEDED by §16 P-round — the companion 'PercentHealthDamage' mark IS now curated (see _notePBaseForm); a CalculationPart.Kind.ByCharLevelInterpolationByDataValue was added and the '2.12%' discrepancy below is resolved (it is the L20 reading, outside the L1-18 range). Original gap analysis retained for history:] The companion 'PercentHealthDamage' calc (the mark-consumption hit itself, i.e. Dauntless Instinct's base '12 + %maxHP' proc, NOT the All Out mark-pop) uses an unrecognized CalculationPart __type ({ee18a47b}). Re-investigated (T8): this part is NOT stack-based -- it has exactly two fields, both unresolved-hash field names whose STRING VALUES are DataValue-name references: 'MarkDamagePercentMin' (DataValues['MarkDamagePercentMin']=0.01) and 'MarkDamagePercentMax' (DataValues['MarkDamagePercentMax']=0.02), both flat/constant across the DataValue's own 7-slot array (i.e. not itself a per-level table -- structurally analogous to ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart's mStartValue/mEndValue pair, but sourced by DataValue name instead of literal numbers). wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/K'Sante (WebFetch, Dauntless Instinct entry) confirms the ratio is '(based on level)', not stacks/missing-health -- ruling out the older 'min/max-by-stacks' guess. HOWEVER the exact interpolation curve could NOT be confirmed: applying the same linear (rank-1)/17 formula FormulaInterpreter already uses for ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart to these two bounds gives exactly 1%->2% (matching Min/Max exactly at rank1/rank18), but the live wiki tooltip states '1% - 2.12% (based on level)' -- 2.12% is LARGER than the BIN's own stored Max (2.00%), so a straightforward min/max-clamped-by-level model is provably inconsistent with the cited live number, and no field in this CalculationPart (or anywhere else in ksante.bin.json) exposes a curve shape/exponent that could explain the extra 0.12pp. Could not resolve this discrepancy (wiki's raw per-level data template returned empty via WebFetch in this sandbox) and will NOT guess a curve to close the gap, per P1/P2. No new CalculationPart.Kind was added to FormulaInterpreter.cs/BinCalculation.cs -- only the mark-POP ('MaxHealthDamagePercent') is curated, not the mark application. Separately: Skarner's passive BIN (skarner.bin.json) was checked and does NOT contain {ee18a47b} anywhere -- its 'PercentHealthDamage'/'DamageMonsterCap' calcs use only already-modeled ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart/NumberCalculationPart, so Skarner.json is unaffected by this issue (left untouched).
_notePBaseForm: P re-curation (§16 P-round, closes the {ee18a47b} gap; GOLDEN_02_KSANTE.md §4). The P mark now curates BOTH stances as three mutually-exclusive-by-stance hits: [0] the ALL-OUT rider 'MaxHealthDamagePercent' (1%maxHP + 0.01%/bonus-Armor + 0.01%/bonus-MR, allOutOnly -> fires only after an R put the combo in All-Out; kept at index 0 so the measured All-Out golden's P_0#cast0h0c0 trace row is unchanged), and the BASE-form mark as [1] flat 'FlatDamage'(=12, baseStanceOnly) + [2] %maxHP 'PercentHealthDamage'(baseStanceOnly). PercentHealthDamage is the previously-uncurated {ee18a47b} part, now supported engine-side as CalculationPart.Kind.ByCharLevelInterpolationByDataValue: a level-1->18 linear interpolation between two NAMED DataValues MarkDamagePercentMin(0.01) -> MarkDamagePercentMax(0.02), i.e. 1%@L1 -> 2%@L18 (matching the BIN's own stored bounds; the old note's '2.12%' wiki value is the L20 reading, OUT of the L1-18 range, so it never contradicted the linear L1-18 curve -- that apparent discrepancy is resolved, not guessed). Base-form P = 12 + [1% + (level-1)/17%] x target maxHP, PHYSICAL. Verified vs GOLDEN_02 §4: config-1 L6 no-items 12 + 0.012941x755 = 21.77 -> x100/136 = 16.0 (measured 16); config-2 L6 items (bonus resists do NOT affect base-form P -- the resist term is the All-Out variant only) 12 + 0.012941x845 = 22.94 -> 16.9 (measured 17). All-Out [R,P] stays the single 6.21 rider (base-form hits dropped by baseStanceOnly). See BinCalculation/ChampionBinParser/FormulaInterpreter for the new part-kind.

_noteWAllOut: W All-Out charge rider (§19, GOLDEN_02_KSANTE.md §7; user disclosure + BIN cross-check 2026-07-14). In All-Out ONLY (allOutOnly -> dropped in base stance, so base-form W is byte-identical to before this hit), W gains a THIRD hit: TRUE damage = f x W_base_raw, where W_base_raw restates W's own base terms (flatDataValue 'BaseDamage' + hpPercentCalc 'TotalMaxHealthDamage' %maxHP, on the pre-All-Out-reduction bonus resists = the live snapshot, which the engine never reduces) and f ramps RDamageIncreaseMin(0.10)->RDamageIncreaseMax(0.80) by the charge knob: f = lerp(Min,Max, clamp01((t-MinChargeTime 0.4)/(TimeToFullCharge 0.9 - 0.4))), t = UserDistanceFraction (M28 charge slider). Unset knob -> Min floor (P2 default); t>=TimeToFullCharge -> capped Max. Every constant is a live BIN DataValue on KSanteW (Hard Rule, no literals). The charge branch (ComboRunner.TryBuildHitShape) reads flatDataValue+hpPercentCalc here to build baseRaw and never falls through to the plain %HP/flat branches, so both base terms living on this one hit is intentional, not a double-count. Fit at full charge (GOLDEN_02 §7): config-1 base 105.4 -> TRUE 84.3 (measured 84); config-2 base 127.0 -> TRUE 101.6 (measured 101). GOLDEN ENCODING DEFERRED to a clean session-C re-measurement (current numbers are session-1 exploit-noised) -- KsanteAllOutWRiderTests asserts the MECHANIC (formula + floor/cap + TRUE + All-Out-only), not a frozen measured datapoint. The per-node charge SLIDER widget in the combo editor is M28's module (M28_NODE_OPTION_UX.md); §19 wires the knob at the engine level (resolver honors UserDistanceFraction; range-exposure shows [floor, full]).
_noteW: W (Path Maker) HARD-CURATED loop 65 (wiki: PHYSICAL, percent-of-max-health); CURATION FIX (Claude Code, GOLDEN #2 K'Sante build+test gate): the original single-hit 'calc':'TotalMaxHealthDamage' dropped the flat BaseDamage(rank) term entirely AND, since a plain 'calc' hit never multiplies by defenderMaxHp, evaluated the %maxHP fraction (mDisplayAsPercent GameCalculation) as if it were already an absolute damage number -- producing ~0.08 instead of ~60 (target's HP barely touched). W's own mSpell has NO 'BaseDamage' GameCalculation (unlike Q, whose same-named calc legitimately sums flat+resist) -- it is a raw per-rank DataValue array [15,45,75,105,135,165,195], so it needs 'flatDataValue' (same shape as Garen R / Sett Q's empowered-AA flat term), not 'calc'. 'TotalMaxHealthDamage' = MaxHealthDamage (%maxHP, 0.08 flat) + Armor/MR bonus-resist ratios (StatByNamedDataValue mStatFormula=2, 0.0002/point) -- the exact same shape K'Sante P already solves via hpPercentCalc/hpBasis Max, so it is now curated the same way (was previously routed through the plain-calc path, which cannot scale by target maxHP at all). Verified against GOLDEN_02_KSANTE.md: config-1 (no items) 45*100/136 + 0.08*755*100/136 = 77.5 (sheet: 77 ±1); config-2 (+40 armor/+45 MR bonus, target 845) 45*100/136 + (0.08+0.0002*85)*845*100/136 = 93.36 (sheet: 93 ±1).
_noteR: R (All Out Slam) — CURATION FIX (Claude Code, GOLDEN_02_KSANTE.md §6, session 3 2026-07-14): re-curated as TWO hits, matching the live tooltip ('80/115/150 physical, ALWAYS' + '+80/115/150 (+5% own bonus health) on WALL IMPACT ONLY'). Hit 1 = flatDataValue 'BaseDamage' (a bare per-rank DataValues array, [45,80,115,150,185,220,255] -- rank1=80, confirming the tooltip; NOT a GameCalculation, so it needs flatDataValue like W's own BaseDamage, not calc). Hit 2 = 'TotalDamageSlamDown' = NamedDataValue('SlamDownStrikeDamage', the SAME array as BaseDamage) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=12 maxHealth, mStatFormula=2 => CASTER'S OWN bonus health, coefficient 0.05) -- the wall-only bonus. Retracts two Lead errors from the prior single-hit note: (1) the old note's hand-calc used BaseDamage[0]=45 (a rank-0 placeholder); the engine's real index==rank convention gives rank1=80, matching the tooltip -- there was no ±29 discrepancy, only a rank-indexing mistake. (2) The 'target max HP basis' hypothesis for the 5% term is retracted -- mStat=12/formula=2 resolves the CASTER's (K'Sante's) own bonus health, consistent with the Tahm Kench BuildStatResolver anchor, not the target's. Re-derivation vs GOLDEN_02_KSANTE.md session-2 measurement (target Kennen 845/36/32, k=100/136=0.7353, K'Sante bonus armor/mr=0): hit1 alone = 80*0.7353 = 58.8 mitigated (NOT the measured 'R' number of 64 by itself) -- the remaining ~5-7 comes from K'Sante's All-Out passive mark-pop (a SEPARATE, already-curated 'P' hit) firing alongside R in the same real cast, not from any missing term in R's own curation; see GoldenKsanteTests' calc-trace-verified rider-attribution test. Type PHYSICAL (wiki-confirmed, unchanged from the prior curation); tagged BurstCeiling (the ult's slam is K'Sante's biggest single scripted hit).
_noteR3: M28 round (CLAUDE_CODE_TODO.md §18 review-condition close, 2026-07-14): hit2 is now a REAL conditional hit — conditionType 'HitsWall' (new, UserAssumed — see ConditionType.HitsWall's doc comment), metCalc 'TotalDamageSlamDown', and deliberately NO 'calc' (the unmet baseline). ComboRunner's conditional-hit resolver tries to evaluate the empty baseline calc name, finds no matching BIN calc, and drops the hit entirely (0 contribution) -- the correct P2 floor for 'did R hit a wall', which the Live Client API cannot observe at all. Default OFF (ComboNode.UserConditionMet unset) = R fires ONLY hit1 (the always-landing flat term); the combo editor's new '최대 데미지(벽꿍)' checkbox (M28 §1) lets the user opt into hit2 when they know the cast connected with a wall. This closes the round-3 review's flagged issue (R previously fired both hits unconditionally, modeling only the best-case 'hits a wall' scenario) -- see GoldenKsanteTests.cs for the updated default-OFF assertions and the new opt-in test.
